info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Loan Repayment Schedule Management API
info.description: This API facilitates the management of repayment schedules associated with specific loans. Users can delete existing repayment schedules to keep financial records accurate and up-to-date. Typical consumers include financial institutions, loan servicers, and application developers who need to maintain compliance and enhance user experience. The API provides operations for both retrieval and modification of repayment schedules, ensuring a streamlined management process for loan portfolios.

delete.summary: Remove a repayment schedule from a loan.
delete.description: This endpoint allows you to delete a specific repayment schedule associated with a loan. Ensure that the repayment schedule is no longer needed before deletion.

requestBody.description: This request body is required to specify the details for deleting a repayment schedule associated with a particular loan. Ensure to provide all necessary information as outlined in the schema.

204.description: The repayment schedule was successfully deleted.
